description: Add a meal to the user's food diary: one or more food items, each with an optional quantity and macros, plus an optional meal label, date, note and provenance `source`. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.

at.description: ISO-8601 instant the meal was eaten; defaults to now.

caffeine_mg.description: Optional caffeine content of this item, in milligrams (e.g. ~95 for a mug of brewed coffee).

fluid_ml.description: Optional fluid/hydration volume of this item, in millilitres (e.g. 240 for an 8 oz cup).

quantity.description: Portion as a display label, e.g. '3', '1 cup' or '2 × 1 frank (96 g)'. Display only: the server stores macros exactly as sent and does not re-scale them.

local_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD diary date; defaults to the user's local date (from their timezone).

source.description: Optional provenance for these items, e.g. 'usda' or 'off' for a food-database result. Defaults to 'client' (an estimate); unrecognized values are recorded as 'client'.

name: log_meal
